description: This Java source file defines the 'AcknowledgementAggregatorActor' class, which is an Akka actor responsible for aggregating acknowledgements received from various sources related to a 'Thing' entity. It manages acknowledgement requests, response handling, timeouts, and final aggregation of acknowledgements, which are then forwarded or processed accordingly.

classes.name: AcknowledgementAggregatorActor
classes.description: An Akka actor class that manages the collection and aggregation of acknowledgements related to a specific 'Thing' entity, handles timeouts, and forwards the aggregated acknowledgements or error responses.
